narrator.name: Narrator
narrator.note: Tells the story of the covenant at Sinai, plain and grave.

the-lord.name: The Lord
the-lord.note: God speaking to Moses on Sinai, giving the judgments and the pattern of the tabernacle; measured, sovereign.

moses.name: Moses
moses.note: Leader and mediator of Israel, about eighty; solemn as he seals the covenant and instructs the elders.

israelites.name: The people of Israel
israelites.note: The whole people answering with one voice, pledging obedience to the covenant.

1.t: Come up to the Lord, thou, and Aaron, Nadab and Abiu, and seventy of the ancients of Israel, and you shall adore afar off.

2.t: And Moses alone shall come up to the Lord, but they shall not come nigh; neither shall the people come up with him.
2.q: The Lord's speech of v.1 continuing, though it names Moses and the Lord in the third person

3.t: So Moses came and told the people all the words of the Lord, and all the judgments: and all the people answered with one voice:
We will do all the words of the Lord, which he hath spoken.

4.t: And Moses wrote all the words of the Lord: and rising in the morning, he built an altar at the foot of the mount, and twelve titles according to the twelve tribes of Israel.

5.t: And he sent young men of the children of Israel, and they offered holocausts, and sacrificed pacific victims of calves to the Lord.

6.t: Then Moses took half of the blood, and put it into bowls; and the rest he poured upon the altar.

7.t: And taking the book of the covenant, he read it in the hearing of the people: and they said:
All things that the Lord hath spoken, we will do, we will be obedient.

8.t: And he took the blood and sprinkled it upon the people, and he said:
This is the blood of the covenant, which the Lord hath made with you concerning all these words.

9.t: Then Moses and Aaron, Nadab and Abiu, and seventy of the ancients of Israel went up:

10.t: And they saw the God of Israel: and under his feet as it were a work of sapphire stone, and as the heaven, when clear.

11.t: Neither did he lay his hand upon those of the children of Israel, that retired afar off, and they saw God, and they did eat and drink.

12.t: And the Lord said to Moses:
Come up to me into the mount, and be there; and I will give thee tables of stone, and the law, and the commandments which I have written; that thou mayest teach them.

13.t: Moses rose up, and his minister Josue: and Moses going up into the mount of God,

14.t: Wait ye here till we return to you. You have Aaron and Hur with you: if any question shall arise, you shall refer it to them.

15.t: And when Moses was gone up, a cloud covered the mount.

16.t: And the glory of the Lord dwelt upon Sinai, covering it with a cloud six days: and the seventh day he called him out of the midst of the cloud.

17.t: And the sight of the glory of the Lord, was like a burning fire upon the top of the mount, in the eyes of the children of Israel.

18.t: And Moses entering into the midst of the cloud, went up into the mountain: And he was there forty days and forty nights.
